title: Lamb Skewers with Greek Yogurt Sauce
description: A classic Greek-inspired dish featuring juicy lamb skewers served with a refreshing yogurt sauce.
instructions: 2. In a large bowl, whisk together lamb, red onion, garlic, salt, and black pepper.
3. Thread lamb mixture onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
4. Brush skewers with olive oil and season with salt and black pepper.
5. Grill skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until cooked to your desired level of doneness.
6. Meanwhile, mix together Greek yogurt, salt, and black pepper in a small bowl.
7. Once skewers are cooked, serve with yogurt sauce for dipping.
